data.title: 信浓 · 和室榻榻米的落肩针织午憩
data.description: 午后阳光暖融融的和室内，信浓身着宽松柔软的浅灰落肩针织毛衣与短裙。毛衣领口微偏，露出柔嫩修长的颈项与锁骨。九条毛茸茸的白狐尾充当了最舒服的天然靠垫，她怀抱着绣花抱枕半卧在草席上，银发如丝垂散。金眸半阖半睁，带着慵懒甜美的睡意，柔声呼唤着你一同入眠。
data.action: reclining sideways on tatami cushion, off-shoulder grey knit loungewear, nine fox tails serving as soft pillows, hugging cushion, golden eyes half-closed in sleepy affection
data.location: traditional Japanese tatami room in warm sunlit afternoon
data.lighting: warm dappled afternoon sunbeams streaming through paper shoji screens
data.mood: cozy dreamlike indulgence, pure tranquil domestic warmth
data.promptProse: Reclining on a sunny tatami mat cushioned by her own nine fluffy white fox tails, Shinano wears an off-shoulder grey knit top. She hugs a soft pillow with sleepy, golden eyes full of tranquil morning affection.
data.animaCaption: Shinano reclining on tatami cushioned by her nine fox tails in an off-shoulder knit top.
